name: Argonne GH200 x1 vLLM Llama-2-7B b64
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench arXiv:2411.00136). vllm, FP16/BF16, 128in/128out. throughput=batch*(in+out)/e2e latency = AGGREGATE across batch. CSV 'Nvidia GH200 GPU' = GH200 Grace Hopper superchip (H100 GPU + Grace CPU over NVLink-C2C). Single-GPU rows only; the CSV has no multi-GPU GH200. bs64 lat 1.91s.
